text: AWS launched in 2006 and remains the largest public cloud provider by market share — well over 200 individual services, available on demand, billed by actual usage.
AWS isn't a single thing you turn on — it's a catalog of services: S3 for storage, Glue for ETL, Redshift for warehousing, Lambda for compute, and two hundred more, each its own tool, used together.

If you've already worked through an Azure course in this catalog, resist mapping every AWS service directly onto its closest Azure equivalent. AWS has its own service boundaries and idioms this course teaches on their own terms.
Cloud and AWS fundamentals first — everything AWS Data Engineering's real depth will assume you already have. Next up: AWS's global infrastructure.
